choices.why: The only velvet three-seater; its clean lines suit the room, and a dark velvet sofa can carry the colorful cushions and throw, though the mustard color isn't an exact match.
A classic natural rattan tub armchair gives the bohemian feel and warm tone, and fits beside the balcony door.
A large blue and rust patterned rug is big enough to anchor the sofa, armchair and table, and it brings the color the user asked for.
The rust-orange cushion with tassels adds warmth and color against the dark sofa and matches the rug's rust tones.
The terracotta embossed ceramic pot is colorful and picks up the rug and cushion tones; it's large enough for a plant by the balcony door.
A medium-height open bookcase is low enough to sit under the window and holds books and small plants.
The carved wooden drum table has a bohemian look and a compact size that suits the space in front of the sofa.
The turned wooden column and linen shade add a warm, vintage touch beside the sofa.
The navy and cream geometric throw adds pattern and color to the sofa arm and goes with the rug.

answer.why: Warm natural woods and rattan, terracotta and rust accents, and blue patterns from the rug and throw give a layered, cheerful bohemian look against the dark velvet sofa and the room's wood floor.
